title: City Council District 4
statement: I stand with Ivy Hill in addressing the pressing issues of commercial contraction and public safety. The recent data shows a concerning trend of decay momentum and crime index, which demands our immediate attention. As the representative of D4, I am committed to working with the city to find solutions that support the local businesses and residents of Ivy Hill.

payload.title: Ivy Hill Revitalization Initiative
payload.problem: Commercial contraction and public safety concerns in Ivy Hill
